title: Adding/changing an advisor Check must update registry + translation parity together
answers: What do I need to touch when adding a new advisor check or step?
Why does CI fail with a translation key error after adding an advisor check?
Can a Check implementation cache state across runs?
Is advisor step code allowed to be non-concurrency-safe?
body:
A new check implements checks.Check + checks.Step (apps/advisor/pkg/app/checks/ifaces.go) in its own pkg/app/checks/<name>/ package AND must be added to checkregistry.Service.Checks() (checkregistry.go) — a check not in that slice never runs and gets no CheckType.
User-facing strings (names/titles/descriptions/resolutions/error-link messages) must come from translations.CheckName/StepTitle/etc. (pkg/translations/embed.go), backed by en-US/grafana-advisor.json; the frontend derives i18n keys itself from IDs (`advisor.{checkTypeID}.name`, `advisor.{checkTypeID}.{stepID}.*`, `advisor.link.{slug}`), so adding a check/step/link requires updating the Go code AND en-US/grafana-advisor.json AND the checkTypeSteps/linkSlugs tables in pkg/translations/parity_test.go, or CI fails.
`Check.Init` is called fresh on every run and every retry and must not cache results across calls (doc comment on checks.Check in ifaces.go) — e.g. datasourcecheck resets its plugin-install cache in Init for this reason.
Steps run concurrently per (step × item) pair via utils.go's runStepsInParallel, capped at 10, with per-step panic recovery — step implementations must be concurrency-safe.
Return a CheckReportFailure for an expected/known issue; only return a Go error for unexpected failures — an error marks the whole Check StatusAnnotationError and the UI shows an error page instead of results.
applies: Applies when adding a new check type, step, or failure-link under apps/advisor/pkg/app/checks/; does not apply to unrelated advisor plumbing (scheduler, admission wiring) changes.
says: New advisor check never runs despite being implemented as Check
CI fails with translation key error after adding advisor check
How do I add a new advisor check or diagnostic step?
Advisor check appears in code but doesn't execute during scans
Adding check requires updates in multiple places for i18n registry
